_about: CleanPilot safety knowledge base: name/what/whatif/rec/path/level(safe|warn)/cost(only on warn: redo = comes back by re-downloading or reinstalling | data = gone for good, re-downloading won't restore it)/grp(general app caches | cn_app China-market apps | dev developer tools)/app(owning app bundle id; its real icon leads the row)/icon(official brand mark filename, only for CLI tools with no .app)/tags(optional cross-group tags, e.g. ai_models; the CLI's --category filters on it)/docs(optional official link). At runtime entries override or extend the built-ins by name; paths support * globs; paths that don't exist never appear in scan results. PRs welcome.

entries.name: ChatGPT desktop crash dumps
entries.what: .dmp reports the ChatGPT desktop app writes when it crashes, used only for diagnostics (the folder is named Codex because that app's bundle id is com.openai.codex)
entries.whatif: Deleting changes nothing functional
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; the next crash writes a fresh report

entries.name: Qoder crash dumps
entries.what: Crash report files generated by Qoder
entries.whatif: Deleting changes nothing functional
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; the next crash writes a fresh report

entries.name: Chrome crash dumps
entries.what: Crash report files generated by Chrome
entries.whatif: Deleting changes nothing functional
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; the next crash writes a fresh report

entries.name: System crash reports
entries.what: DiagnosticReports — crash diagnostics for the system and your apps
entries.whatif: The system keeps running unchanged
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; the system writes new reports when something crashes

entries.name: nvm download cache
entries.what: Node installers nvm downloaded
entries.whatif: Node versions you already installed are unaffected
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; nvm install re-downloads when needed

entries.name: npm cache folder
entries.what: npm's entire cache directory, including that _cacache content-addressed download cache
entries.whatif: Global packages you already installed are unaffected; the next install re-downloads dependencies
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; npm install rebuilds it

entries.name: tnpm cache
entries.what: The cache folder of the tnpm corporate npm mirror
entries.whatif: The next install re-downloads
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; the next install rebuilds it

entries.name: npminstall packages
entries.what: The .tgz packages npminstall downloaded
entries.whatif: The next install re-downloads
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; the next install rebuilds it

entries.name: pnpm store
entries.what: pnpm's global store; projects reuse it through hard links
entries.whatif: Files already hard-linked into each node_modules stay; only the store is emptied
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; pnpm install fetches missing packages

entries.name: yarn cache
entries.what: yarn's download cache
entries.whatif: The next install re-downloads
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; yarn install rebuilds it

entries.name: bun cache
entries.what: bun's install cache
entries.whatif: The next install re-downloads
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; bun install rebuilds it

entries.name: Gradle cache
entries.what: Gradle's build cache and dependency repository
entries.whatif: The next build re-downloads every dependency from scratch (noticeably slower the first time)
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; the next build re-downloads. On an offline machine, check your mirror first

entries.name: Maven dependency repository
entries.what: Maven's local dependency repository at ~/.m2/repository
entries.whatif: The first build re-downloads everything (can be slow)
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; Maven fetches what builds need. Offline machines need a mirror configured first

entries.name: pip cache
entries.what: Source and wheel packages pip downloaded
entries.whatif: The next install re-downloads
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; pip install rebuilds it

entries.name: Homebrew cache
entries.what: Installation packages brew downloaded
entries.whatif: Installed software is unaffected
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; brew re-downloads when you reinstall

entries.name: conda package cache
entries.what: conda's pkgs cache directory
entries.whatif: Environments you already created are unaffected
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; conda re-downloads on demand

entries.name: Xcode DerivedData
entries.what: Per-project build intermediates and indexes kept by Xcode
entries.whatif: The first build and index are slower once
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; Xcode rebuilds it when you open the project

entries.name: Xcode archives
entries.what: Historical .xcarchive bundles Xcode produced when packaging for upload
entries.whatif: That build's archive is gone; you can no longer export its ipa
entries.rec: Can't be restored directly; back it up first if you need it for release, or rebuild from the same commit

entries.name: Xcode iOS DeviceSupport
entries.what: Debug symbols copied over for real-device debugging on old system versions
entries.whatif: Debugging on older real devices regenerates it
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; Xcode regenerates it when you connect a device on that system version

entries.name: Xcode simulator devices
entries.what: The full disk image of every iOS simulator, along with the apps, data and sign-ins stored inside
entries.whatif: The next launch gives you a blank device — its apps and data go with it
entries.rec: Can't be restored directly; recreate the simulator in Xcode

entries.name: Simulator on-demand assets
entries.what: System assets the simulator downloads on demand (Siri, speech recognition and other dmgs), held in each device's MobileAsset
entries.whatif: Delete them and the simulator fetches them again the first time that feature is used; the simulator and the app data inside are untouched
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; the system downloads it again on demand

entries.name: Simulator shared cache
entries.what: The dynamic-link shared cache and symbol data (uuidtext) every app in the simulator shares, generated by the system
entries.whatif: Delete it and the simulator regenerates it on next launch; the first start is a little slower
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; the system rebuilds it at startup

entries.name: iOS device backups
entries.what: Full-device backups of your iPhone/iPad made on this Mac
entries.whatif: These historical backups are gone; the device itself is fine
entries.rec: Deleted backups can't come back; reconnect the device to make a fresh one

entries.name: Docker data
entries.what: Images, containers and volumes owned by Docker Desktop
entries.whatif: Deleting this wipes every local image and container
entries.rec: No per-item restore; reopen Docker Desktop to pull images and rebuild containers. Cleaning inside Docker Desktop is safer

entries.name: Main cache folder
entries.what: ~/Library/Caches — the cache folder shared by all apps
entries.whatif: Apps start slower once, then rebuild what they need
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; apps rebuild it on launch

entries.name: App logs
entries.what: ~/Library/Logs — log files your apps wrote
entries.whatif: Old logs are gone but nothing breaks
entries.rec: Old logs don't come back; apps keep writing new ones

entries.name: Trash
entries.what: Things waiting in the Finder Trash for your call
entries.whatif: Space frees only when emptied, and emptying is permanent
entries.rec: Drag files back from Finder until it's emptied

entries.name: WeChat cache
entries.what: Runtime packages for embedded components such as mini-programs and Search, stored per account
entries.whatif: Chat history and sign-in are untouched; WeChat re-downloads a component the next time you open it
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; WeChat re-downloads it on demand

entries.name: WeChat mini-program shared libraries
entries.what: Base runtime libraries shared by every mini-program, kept as one versioned copy
entries.whatif: Chat history is untouched; WeChat re-downloads it when a mini-program opens
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; WeChat re-downloads it on demand

entries.name: WeChat web cache
entries.what: HTTP cache from WeChat's built-in browser: Moments, articles, web pages
entries.whatif: Sign-in state lives in a different folder; pages reload their assets when opened again
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; WeChat rebuilds it as needed

entries.name: WeChat logs
entries.what: WeChat's own run logs, dated .xlog files used for troubleshooting
entries.whatif: Features and chat history are unaffected; this stretch of log is just gone
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; WeChat keeps writing new logs

entries.name: WeChat image cache
entries.what: Images and stickers left behind while browsing chats and Moments; the originals of the same picture sit under msg, these are display copies
entries.whatif: Chat history and the original images are unaffected; these copies get rebuilt when opened again
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; WeChat rebuilds it on demand

entries.name: WeChat temporary files
entries.what: Temporary files left by sending and receiving, such as ImageTemp, stored per account
entries.whatif: Saved chat history is unaffected
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; WeChat recreates the folder itself

entries.name: WeChat plugin runtime
entries.what: Runtime packages for WeChat plugins, covering calls, media and transfers; an update can leave several versions behind, each one a complete copy
entries.whatif: Deleting the version in use breaks those features until WeChat restarts; removed versions re-download when needed
entries.rec: Quit WeChat before deleting; WeChat re-downloads what it needs

entries.name: QQ cache
entries.what: QQ's temporary cache on this Mac
entries.whatif: Chat history and sign-in are untouched
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; QQ rebuilds it on demand

entries.name: QQ chat photos and videos
entries.what: New QQ chat photos, videos and files, stored per account
entries.whatif: Text history stays; photos and videos re-download when opened again
entries.rec: No local restore; open the chat on your phone and QQ re-downloads it

entries.name: DingTalk cache
entries.what: DingTalk's temporary cache on this Mac
entries.whatif: Chat history and sign-in are untouched
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; DingTalk rebuilds it on demand

entries.name: DingTalk logs
entries.what: Runtime logs DingTalk writes (commonly a few hundred MB)
entries.whatif: Old logs are gone but nothing breaks
entries.rec: Old logs don't come back; DingTalk keeps writing new ones

entries.name: DingTalk chat data
entries.what: DingTalk chat photos, videos and files, stored per account
entries.whatif: Text history stays; media re-downloads, but local file originals are gone
entries.rec: No local restore; re-download from the chat on your phone (while not expired)

entries.name: WeCom cache
entries.what: WeCom's temporary cache on this Mac
entries.whatif: Chat history and sign-in are untouched
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; WeCom rebuilds it on demand

entries.name: WeCom chat data
entries.what: WeCom chat photos, videos and files, stored per account
entries.whatif: Text history stays; photos and videos re-download when opened again
entries.rec: No local restore; re-download in the matching chat on your phone

entries.name: Ollama models
entries.what: The large model weights Ollama pulled — a single model is often tens of GB
entries.whatif: Those models have to be downloaded again before you can use them
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; ollama pull <model> downloads it again

entries.name: uv download cache
entries.what: Packages and prebuilt wheels uv downloaded for your Python dependencies
entries.whatif: Setting up the environment next time re-downloads and is slower once
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; uv rebuilds it on its next run

entries.name: Codex CLI runtime install
entries.what: The Node runtime and dependencies Codex CLI fetched for itself
entries.whatif: The next codex launch re-fetches its runtime
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; running codex again reinstalls it

entries.name: Gradle version downloads
entries.what: The Gradle distributions gradlew downloaded for the versions your projects declare
entries.whatif: The next build re-downloads that version
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; the next ./gradlew re-downloads it

entries.name: chrome-devtools-mcp browser builds
entries.what: The Chrome for Testing builds chrome-devtools-mcp downloads to drive
entries.whatif: This MCP re-downloads the browser the next time it starts
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; the next start re-downloads it

entries.name: Hugging Face model cache
entries.what: Models and datasets downloaded by transformers / datasets — one of them can be tens of GB
entries.whatif: Those models have to be downloaded again before use; gated ones need you to sign in again
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; it re-downloads by model repository name

entries.name: Whisper model cache
entries.what: The language model weights openai-whisper downloaded
entries.whatif: The next transcription re-downloads the model
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; running whisper again downloads it

entries.name: cargo registry
entries.what: The crates.io index and dependency sources cargo fetched
entries.whatif: The next Rust build re-downloads its dependencies
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; cargo build rebuilds it

entries.name: IntelliJ IDEA cache
entries.what: Indexes, local history and build caches IntelliJ IDEA keeps
entries.whatif: Opening a project rebuilds its indexes; your project settings don't live here
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; the IDE rebuilds it when you open the project

entries.name: PyCharm cache
entries.what: Indexes, local history and build caches PyCharm keeps
entries.whatif: Opening a project rebuilds its indexes; your project settings don't live here
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; the IDE rebuilds it when you open the project

entries.name: Android Studio cache
entries.what: Android Studio's indexes, build caches and logs
entries.whatif: Opening a project rebuilds its indexes first
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; the IDE rebuilds it

entries.name: Android emulator images
entries.what: System images of your Android virtual devices (AVDs) and the data stored inside them
entries.whatif: These virtual devices go, along with the apps and data inside
entries.rec: Can't be restored directly; recreate the device in Device Manager

entries.name: Android SDK
entries.what: Android platforms, build tools and system images installed by sdkmanager
entries.whatif: No Android project can build until the SDK is reinstalled
entries.rec: Can't be restored directly; reinstall it with sdkmanager

entries.name: Go module cache
entries.what: Source of the dependency modules go downloaded
entries.whatif: The next build re-downloads the dependencies
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; go mod download rebuilds it

entries.name: Go build cache
entries.what: Intermediates produced by go builds
entries.whatif: The first build is slower once
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; go build rebuilds it

entries.name: CocoaPods cache
entries.what: The pod source archives CocoaPods downloaded
entries.whatif: The next pod install re-downloads them
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; pod install re-downloads it

entries.name: SwiftPM cache
entries.what: Copies of the dependency repositories Swift Package Manager cloned
entries.whatif: Resolving dependencies re-clones them the first time
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; Xcode or swift build fetches them again

entries.name: oMLX local models
entries.what: MLX model weights downloaded by oMLX, one whole copy per model repository
entries.whatif: These models can no longer run; oMLX itself is unaffected
entries.rec: No recovery needed; oMLX downloads these tens of GB again when you need them

entries.name: OrbStack virtual machine disk
entries.what: OrbStack's Linux VM disk image and swap file — every container, image and line of code lives inside this one file (the image looks like 460 GB but is sparse, so it takes far less)
entries.whatif: The virtual machine disappears along with every container, image and line of code inside it
entries.rec: No recovery; you can only rebuild the VM and set the environment up again

entries.name: iOS Simulator runtime
entries.what: iOS Simulator system image (dmg) downloaded from the App Store; Xcode needs it to run the simulator
entries.whatif: Simulators of that version will no longer start, and Xcode will ask you to download it again
entries.rec: No recovery needed; download it again from Xcode when you need it, tens of GB at a time

entries.name: Qoder runtime logs
entries.what: Runtime logs from every Qoder session and background task; they pile up the longer you use it
entries.whatif: Only affects digging through logs after the fact; the editor itself is unaffected
entries.rec: No recovery needed; rebuilt automatically on the next launch

entries.name: Qoder session records
entries.what: Per-project conversation and task records kept by Qoder (one folder per project; a single jsonl can reach hundreds of MB)
entries.whatif: Past conversations with the Agent in those projects can no longer be looked up
entries.rec: No recovery; the conversation history exists only here

entries.name: ZCode runtime data
entries.what: Runtime data left behind by the ZCode command line: session database, model call recordings, generated artifacts, image cache
entries.whatif: You lose ZCode's session history and generated artifacts; logs and image cache can be rebuilt, the database cannot
entries.rec: No recovery; if you just want space, delete only the log and image-cache inside it

entries.name: Hermes pre-upgrade snapshot
entries.what: State snapshot Hermes takes automatically before an upgrade, so you can roll back if the new version misbehaves
entries.whatif: You can no longer roll back to the pre-upgrade state
entries.rec: No recovery; once the new version is clearly fine, this copy is of no use

entries.name: LM Studio models
entries.what: Model weights LM Studio downloaded locally — a single model is often several GB
entries.whatif: Deleted models must be downloaded again before you can use them
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; download them again in LM Studio

entries.name: Jan models
entries.what: Model weights Jan downloaded locally, kept in its data folder
entries.whatif: Deleted models must be downloaded again; your conversations are unaffected
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; download them again from Jan's model page

entries.name: GPT4All models
entries.what: Model weights GPT4All downloaded locally, mostly GGUF files
entries.whatif: Deleted models must be downloaded again before you can use them
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; get them again from GPT4All's download page

entries.name: Draw Things models
entries.what: Image-generation models Draw Things downloaded, kept inside its sandbox container
entries.whatif: Deleted models must be downloaded again; your artwork is unaffected
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; download them again from Draw Things' model page

entries.name: DiffusionBee models
entries.what: Stable Diffusion model files DiffusionBee downloaded
entries.whatif: Deleted models must be downloaded again before you can use them
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; download them again in DiffusionBee

entries.name: llama.cpp model cache
entries.what: GGUF models downloaded by llama-run and friends, kept in the user cache by default
entries.whatif: Deleted models are downloaded again the next time you run it
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; llama-run re-downloads on demand

entries.name: PyTorch Hub cache
entries.what: Pretrained models and code downloaded by torch.hub
entries.whatif: Loading the same model next time downloads it again
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; torch.hub.load re-downloads automatically

entries.name: Codex session records
entries.what: Session replays Codex CLI saves by date — one rollout-*.jsonl per conversation
entries.whatif: Those past conversations can no longer be looked up in codex
entries.rec: No recovery; the conversation history exists only here

entries.name: Codex runtime logs
entries.what: Runtime logs the Codex CLI terminal writes; they pile up the longer you use it
entries.whatif: Only affects digging through logs after the fact; codex itself is unaffected
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; the next run writes them again

entries.name: Codex plugin and marketplace checkouts
entries.what: Git checkouts Codex CLI makes for its plugins and skill marketplace, .git and all
entries.whatif: Plugins and the marketplace have to be fetched again; config.toml and the installed runtime are unaffected
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; starting codex again re-checks them out

entries.name: Claude Code session records
entries.what: Conversations Claude Code saves per project path (one folder per project, a stack of jsonl rounds inside)
entries.whatif: Past conversations in those projects can no longer be looked up
entries.rec: No recovery; the conversation history exists only here

entries.name: Qoder session workspace
entries.what: Per-session scratch folder Qoder keeps: tool call output, screenshots and image attachments it captured, session logs
entries.whatif: Screenshots and tool output from old sessions won't open; the conversation text itself is unaffected
entries.rec: No recovery; a session still running makes its own folder

entries.name: Qoder file history
entries.what: Version snapshots Qoder keeps of files the Agent edited — one folder per session, each file stored as @v1 @v2
entries.whatif: You can no longer diff or roll back files the Agent edited, version by version
entries.rec: No recovery; a new version appears only once the Agent edits a file again

entries.name: ZCode embedded browser web cache
entries.what: Web resource cache ZCode's embedded browser builds up per partition; one partition alone can reach 1 GB
entries.whatif: Nothing breaks; web pages just download their resources again
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; pages you visit get cached again on their own

entries.name: ZCode embedded browser script cache
entries.what: Compiled script and style cache from ZCode's embedded browser
entries.whatif: Nothing breaks; pages just recompile the first time you open them
entries.rec: Nothing to restore; rebuilt when you open the page again
